explication: Uno Platform is a cross-platform .NET UI framework that presents a WinUI-style API for applications targeting web, desktop, mobile, and embedded devices. At runtime, app code uses framework APIs that are implemented across platform targets; the README describes Skia and native rendering options. The tree and sampled sources also show a developer workflow: the CLI discovers a workspace and manages MCP/dev-server sessions, while Hot Reload processes changes in a running app. Several platform implementations and README capabilities are not represented in the sampled source, so their internal links are omitted.
